description: 卡罗-卡恩推进变 B12 — f6挑战楔子打通f线

intro.popup_en:
Open Files, Practice 10: Break Through on the f-File
White's e5-pawn forms a central wedge. Black challenges it with ...f6; after ...fxe5, the f-file opens and becomes a source of pressure.
intro.popup:
f线突破 练亘10

e5楔子封锁中心！

黑方反击：
f6挑战楔子！
fxe5打通f线！

f线开放→强大压力！

outro.popup_en: Summary: cxd4 opens the c-file, Ne1-e3 reinforces the e5 wedge, and ...f6 followed by ...fxe5 removes the wedge and opens the f-file. Black has freed the position and can activate the rook on f8.
outro.popup:
f线开放小结
✅ cxd4：c线打通
✅ Ne1→Ne3：守护e5
✅ f6！fxe5：f线打通！

核心成果：
消灭e5楔子→f线开放
→Rf8施压→黑方优势！

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game.
...c6 begins the Caro-Kann Defense.
d4 expands in the center.
...d5 challenges the center.
e5! The Advance Variation. White establishes a pawn wedge that closes the center.
moves.popup:
e5！推进变！
白方楔子封锁中心

moves.popup_en: ...Bf5 develops the bishop outside the pawn chain.
Nf3 develops a knight.
...e6 reinforces Black's center.
Be2 develops the bishop.
...c5! Black counterattacks, preparing to open the c-file.
moves.popup:
c5！黑方反击！
c线即将打通！

moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king.
...Nc6 develops a knight.
c3 reinforces White's center and prepares to recapture after ...cxd4.
...Nge7 develops a knight.
Na3 develops and prepares to reroute the knight to c2.
...cxd4! The exchange opens the c-file. Both sides now have a clear route on that file.
moves.popup:
cxd4！兑换！
c线打通！
双方c列都无阻隔！

moves.popup_en: cxd4 recaptures, leaving the c-file completely open.
moves.popup:
cxd4白方回吃
c线完全开放！

moves.popup_en: ...Ng6 develops the knight to control central squares.

moves.popup:
Nc2机动
马到c2 准备更好位置
moves.popup_en: Nc2 reroutes the knight toward a more useful square.
...Be7 develops the bishop.
Ne1! White reroutes the knight f3-e1-e3 to reinforce the e5 wedge.
moves.popup:
Ne1！马重新部署！
f3→e1→e3
守护e5楔子

moves.popup_en: ...f6! Black's key counterbreak challenges the e5 wedge and prepares to open the f-file.
moves.popup:
f6！黑方关键反击！
挑战e5楔子！
f线即将打开！

moves.popup_en: Ne3! The knight reinforces e5 and holds the central wedge.
moves.popup:
Ne3！白马守e5！
坚守楔子，争夺中心

moves.popup_en: ...fxe5! Black removes the e5 wedge and fully opens the f-file. The rook on f8 can now exert pressure along the file.
moves.popup:
fxe5！黑方消灭e5楔子！
f线完全打开！
黑Rf8将在f线发威！

moves.popup_en: dxe5 restores White's central presence, but the f-file is open for Black. Black has freed the position and can activate the rook on f8 to pressure White.
moves.popup:
dxe5白方重守中心
f线已对黑方全面开放！

黑方战略成果：
• f线开放→Rf8强压
• e5楔子被消除
黑方开放线优势已建立！
